name: travel-home-action-soft-glass
label: 首页学习入口柔光旅行插画
reference: 用户提供的方案 A 扁长卡片模板
preamble: Soft luminous travel-learning spot illustrations with rounded filled geometry, translucent glass highlights, gentle blue or mint gradients, crisp edges, no outline, no cast shadow, and no text.

construction.grid: 24-unit keyline; live area about 76%; optical centering
construction.angles: front-facing shapes with restrained 30- and 45-degree folds
construction.detail_budget: one core metaphor; no more than five main shapes
construction.fill_rule: rounded filled silhouettes with a restrained translucent highlight
construction.color_rule: blue family for learning subjects, mint family for reading subjects, white only for small highlights
construction.shared_parts: reuse circular dots, pill terminals, and softly folded panels
construction.perspective: flat front-facing with very shallow dimensional overlap
construction.shadow: no shadow cast onto the background
construction.motif: one small translucent circular or pill-shaped highlight

outputs.project: transparent RGBA PNG composed into the two home action cards
